title: Continuous functions are locally Lebesgue integrable
statement: Use $\mathbf R,\mathbf C$ [def-weil-field]. Let $m\geq1$, let $U\subseteq\mathbf R^m$ be open, and let $f:\mathbf R^m\to\mathbf C$ be continuous on $U$. Then $f$ is locally Lebesgue integrable on $U$: $f$ is Lebesgue measurable on $U$ and for each $x\in U$ there is a neighborhood $N$ of $x$ such that $\int_{N\cap U}|f(t)|\,dt<\infty$.
